name: application-consent-checklist
title: Consent Checklist
description: Required-agreement checklist that gates a submit button until every required item is checked — distinct from a plain application-checkboxes list, which has no submission-gating behavior.
useWhen: Requiring explicit agreement to terms, a privacy policy, or an age confirmation before account creation.
Collecting granular data-processing consent where some items are required and others optional.
Disabling a submit action until every required checkbox is checked, with visible help text explaining why.
avoidWhen: The checkboxes are ordinary form options with no gating behavior — use application-checkboxes instead.
Only one agreement exists — a single inline checkbox next to the submit button is simpler than a list.
Consent must be recorded with a timestamp and audit trail — this component is presentation only; wire your own consent-logging backend.
responsiveBehavior: The card has a fixed max width; each checkbox label wraps its text normally at any width without truncation.
accessibility: Each checkbox is wrapped in a real label so the whole label text is part of the click target and the accessible name.
The disabled submit button in variant 1 carries aria-disabled reflecting its real disabled state, paired with help text explaining the requirement.
Required and Optional badges in variant 2 use both text and a color difference, not color alone.

variants.title: Gated submit
variants.description: Agreement checklist that disables the submit button, with help text, until every item is checked.
accessibility: The disabled submit button carries aria-disabled and is paired with visible help text stating the requirement.

variants.title: Gated submit (Dark)
variants.description: Gated-submit consent checklist adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Enabled and disabled button states must remain visually distinct on dark backgrounds.

variants.title: Select-all with required/optional badges
variants.description: Consent list with a select-all master checkbox and a Required or Optional badge per item, for granular data-processing consent.
accessibility: The select-all checkbox is a real, separately labeled control distinct from the individual item checkboxes.

variants.title: Select-all with required/optional badges (Dark)
variants.description: Select-all consent checklist adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Required and Optional badge contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
